subject: Ride, a javafx based IDE for Renjin

messages.author: 42e5316f884713d9
messages.subject: Ride, a javafx based IDE for Renjin
parts:
Hi,

FYI: I just released 1.0 beta 2 of Ride here: https://github.com/perNyfelt/ride/releases

Ride aims to be very similar to RStudio in terms of capabilities and functionality. It executes R scripts in the Renjin ScriptEngine. I think it complements REPL in a nice way.

Best regards,
Per
